result.summary: The residential street features sidewalks on both sides but lacks essential crossing infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The roadway surface is degraded, and parked vehicles near the intersection corners create visual obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.description: The lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection increases risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the corner makes the sidewalk inaccessible for people with mobility impairments.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct curb ramps with tactile warning pads at all intersection corners.

interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. The wide, unmarked roadway increases pedestrian exposure and may encourage higher vehicle speeds due to the open geometry.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians unprotected and without a designated right-of-way.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Exposure
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and wide street width increases pedestrian exposure time during crossing.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the corner on the right side can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The environment is a wide residential street lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, lane markings, and a continuous sidewalk network. The broad, undefined roadway and poor pavement quality create a hostile environment for pedestrians, particularly when crossing.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points for pedestrians at the intersection or along the block.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt creates uneven surfaces for both vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Striping
interventions.description: Add lane markings to narrow the perceived travel lane and encourage slower driving speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, though they appear to be in fair to poor condition with some vegetation growth. There is a lack of marked pedestrian infrastructure such as crosswalks or curb ramps at the visible intersection, and on-street parking may create sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the visible intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked pavement without priority.

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb may block the view between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross the street.

hazards.name: Poor sidewalk maintenance
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and vegetation growth on the sidewalk create potential tripping hazards.
